description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Price on Maize
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes a maximum retail price for maize, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for commercial activities. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
